title: Approval of Resolution for Estimated Water Supply Cost, Water Quality
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Financial Officer
  Approval of Resolution for Estimated Water Supply Cost, Water Quality
  Improvement, and Owens Valley Regulatory Adjustments. The proposed
  Resolution authorizes expenditures for a 12-month period, commencing
  January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2027.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
summary: Resolution authorizing expenditures for Estimated Water Supply Cost, Water Quality Improvement, and Owens Valley Regulatory Adjustments for 2027.
